diagnosis: cancel_pipeline_job accepts an arbitrary job_id and invokes job.cancel() and job.delete() directly on the Redis connection. It never validates that job.meta['organization_id'] corresponds to request.user.organization_id. A rogue or compromised user can abort mission-critical ingestion pipelines, data synchronization, and nightly billing runs of competing tenant organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /api/pipelines/jobs/job_sync_tenant_99812_nightly/cancel/ HTTP/1.1
Host: datasync.pipeline-corp.io
Authorization: Bearer <untrusted_customer_token>
Content-Length: 0
